core.title: Flawed Soil Moisture Sensor Calibration Dataset
core.description: A deliberately flawed upload sample where a DOI is placed in the cstr_identifier field. The backend should not populate the core CSTR field with this value, but should preserve it as an alternative identifier and use it as the domain identifier with a DOI marker.

dataset_basic_information.Title: Flawed Soil Moisture Sensor Calibration Dataset
dataset_basic_information.Abstract: This file intentionally puts a DOI into cstr_identifier to verify that CSTR validation and DOI fallback behavior are both working.

Scope.Spatial Range: Controlled soil-column experiments in Beijing, China

dataset_basic_information.File Content: Sensor calibration CSV files, laboratory logs, calibration coefficients, and validation plots.

dataset_service_information.Dataset Citation: Example Sensor Laboratory. Flawed Soil Moisture Sensor Calibration Dataset. Example Agricultural Data Center, 2026.
dataset_service_information.Dataset Usage Statement: Use this file only for validating upload error handling.

extension_info: Expected behavior: core CSTR is Not extracted/未提取到; alternative identifier contains 10.9999/flawed.soil-moisture.2026; domain identifier shows DOI marker.
